issues.title: Kanban drag-and-drop puts a card or lane exactly where the drop indicator shows
issues.trigger: In Board view with manual sort and no filter: drag a card down inside its own lane (e.g. A in [A,B,C] dropped in the gap before C), or drop it on the lower half of itself; or drag a lane by its grip to any slot except the first on a board whose lanes hold cards.
issues.what_to_build: Two index bugs in the Board view drag handlers. (1) Cards: handleItemDragOver/handleItemDrop (src/lib/plugins/kanban/KanbanView.svelte:365-405) compute the slot among all rendered cards, the dragged card included, and moveItem (src/lib/plugins/kanban/kanban.logic.ts:446-450) removes the card before splicing at that index. A downward move inside one lane therefore lands one slot below the indicator ([A,B,C], A dropped before C gives [B,C,A]), and dropping on the lower half of the card itself moves it down by one. (2) Lanes: handleLaneDrop (KanbanView.svelte:434-456) indexes container.querySelectorAll('[data-lane-id]'), but every card also carries data-lane-id (KanbanCard.svelte:173), so the index counts cards; moveLane (kanban.logic.ts:502-505) rejects the out-of-range index and the drop silently does nothing, or targets the wrong lane. Even with only lanes counted, a rightward lane move has the same remove-then-insert off-by-one (kanban.logic.ts:508-509). Fix direction: compute the lane drop index over lane elements only (a selector or attribute cards do not carry), and map the visual slot to the post-removal index when the source sits before the slot, for both cards in one lane and lanes. Keep cross-lane card moves as they are (they are right today).

issues.title: A kanban card or lane title being edited is saved into its own board when the tab changes, and never into another tab
issues.trigger: Double-click a card (or a lane title), type, and without pressing Enter or clicking elsewhere switch tabs with a keyboard shortcut, close the tab with Cmd+W, or quit.
issues.what_to_build: The typed text lives only in the card textarea's local state (src/lib/plugins/kanban/KanbanCard.svelte:61, :189-195) or the lane title input (src/lib/plugins/kanban/KanbanLane.svelte:249-253) and reaches the board only through commitEdit on blur or Enter. KanbanView is not keyed by path and persists through onContentChange (src/lib/app/EditorView.svelte:80), which writes tabs[activeIndex] (src/lib/core/editor/editor.service.ts:254-256, editor.store.svelte.ts:84-88). A keyboard tab switch or Cmd+W unmounts the view with the edit still open: if WebKit fires no blur on removal the edit is dropped; if it does, applyChange compares against the new tab's content (KanbanView.svelte:87) and writes the board markdown into the note now in front, which autosave then writes to disk. Which of the two happens was not verified in the running app. Issue 01 already flagged this site as a follow-up. Fix direction: mirror the canvas fix: key KanbanView by path and persist through a path-scoped writer (onContentChangeForPath with a path read once), compare against the instance's own last content rather than the live prop, and commit a pending card or lane-title edit when the view is torn down. The close and quit paths should use the same pre-removal flush mechanism Issue 22 picks for canvas.

refuted.reason: Svelte Flow 1.7 does not grow a parent while a child is dragged. calculateNodePosition skips the parent clamp for expandParent (node_modules/.pnpm/@xyflow+system@0.0.83/.../index.mjs:431), so the card can leave the group, but handleExpandParent runs only from updateNodeInternals on a dimension change (index.mjs:1934-1946), never on a position change, and @xyflow/svelte dist has no other expandParent handling. A card dropped fully outside the group therefore has no intersecting group, and the un-parent branch at src/lib/features/canvas/CanvasInner.svelte:155-170 runs. A card dropped partly over the group stays a child, which is the partial-overlap rule of getIntersectingNodes and not a resize. Checked by reading the library source, not by running the app.

Improbable in daily use. It needs a typed filter, then a click on the board background (the filter input itself is skipped at src/lib/plugins/kanban/KanbanView.svelte:240), then arrow keys and Space or Backspace on a ring the user cannot see. With a sort active the ring sits on the card that gets toggled or deleted (focusedItemId comes from the same stored index, KanbanView.svelte:527), so what changes is the ringed card and nothing is hidden. The only real case is filter plus keyboard plus Delete, which is a theoretical chain.

issues.title: A QueryJS block run in the seconds after a save shows the saved tags, tasks and links once the index catches up, and never keeps a pre-save result in the cache
issues.trigger: The owner ticks a task, adds a tag or a wikilink in a note, then within about 2 s switches to a dashboard note. The save on tab switch (or Cmd+S) clears the QueryJS cache. The dashboard block runs under 'always' (or auto-runs on a first open after the tab was closed) and caches its result.
issues.what_to_build: notifyAfterSave (src/lib/core/editor/editor.hooks.ts:81-83) updates Rust and then clears the QueryJS result cache at once, but execute() reads tags, tasks and outgoing links from getVaultEntries() (src/lib/plugins/queryjs/queryjs-block-widget.ts:243), a memo keyed on vaultStore.vaultIndexVersion (src/lib/core/vault/vault-entries.service.ts:26-29). That version only advances in the throttled vault-index-updated refresh (src/lib/app/tauri-listeners.service.ts:106-109, refresh() :267-268), 2 s after an isolated event and up to 10 s in a burst. A run in that window reads the pre-save snapshot (frontmatter is already fresh, because the property index is a synchronous note-change consumer), and setResult (queryjs-block-widget.ts:270) caches it. When the version bump lands, nothing drops that result, so the stale DOM is re-attached on every tab switch until some other note is saved. CLAUDE.md Indexing 12 accepts the lag of a read; it does not accept a lagged result being cached as final. Fix direction: remember the index version (or the entries snapshot) a cached result was computed from, and treat a result older than the current snapshot as a cache miss once the refresh advances the memo (for example clear results on the refresh bump when any cached result predates it). Keep the existing policy semantics for a miss (Always re-runs, First open/Manual show Run). Do not make every save bypass the refresh throttle.

A result computed at the current index version is still re-attached on re-render, with no re-run and no extra get_all_vault_entries_v2 call (the canvas/DOM persistence of ADR 0010 holds).
Under 'first-open' with the tab still open and under 'manual', a stale result after the bump renders the Run button, the same as after a save.

issues.title: DataArray sort and sortBy keep the items that have the key in order and group the items without it at one end
issues.trigger: A dashboard sorts pages by an optional frontmatter field, e.g. kb.pages('#project').sort(p => p.priority, 'desc') or sortBy(p => p.due), and some notes lack the field (or have it empty).
issues.what_to_build: sort (src/lib/plugins/queryjs/data-array.ts:119-128) compares raw keys with va < vb ? -1 : va > vb ? 1 : 0. An undefined key compares equal to every value, so the comparator is not transitive and V8's sort leaves the defined values out of order (keys [5, undefined, 3, 1] ascending come out [5, undefined, 1, 3]). A null key coerces to 0 and sorts as a number. Make the comparator a total order: treat undefined and null as missing and place all missing keys together at one end (Dataview-compatible choice: the implementer picks one end and documents it), in both directions, with the defined keys sorted normally. sortBy delegates to sort, so one fix covers both.

The same holds with 'desc' ([5, 3, 1] in order, missing grouped at the chosen end) and through sortBy.
A null key is treated as missing, not as 0.
KBDateTime keys (due dates) with some notes missing the field sort by date with the missing ones grouped.
Arrays where every item has the key sort exactly as today (existing sort tests stay green).
help/documentation/13-queryjs.md sort section states where notes without the field go.
